Method of Attack: Runs a malicious container to fetch a Bash script disguised as a PNG image

Creates a cronjob in the container to download and execute a Bash file (a.asp) that kills competing mining processes and daemons, deletes IOC file paths, kills network connections to competing cryptomining C2s, disables Alibaba Cloud monitoring service
Downloads and runs the cryptomining utility XMRig with a configuration file hiding wallets behind proxy pools
Attempts lateral movement by leveraging SSH keys found on the filesystem to repeat infection
Impacted Systems: Linux servers with exposed Docker APIs
Indicators of Compromise: Bash script disguised as PNG image
